The third [[Campaign (role-playing games)|campaign]] of the ''[[Dungeons & Dragons]]'' [[web series]] ''[[Critical Role]]'' premiered on October 21, 2021 and concluded on February 6, 2025; it is set after the conclusion of the [[Critical Role (campaign two)|second campaign]] and ''[[Exandria Unlimited]]''. The series stars [[Marisha Ray]], [[Ashley Johnson]], [[Laura Bailey]], [[Travis Willingham]], [[Liam O'Brien]], [[Taliesin Jaffe]], and [[Sam Riegel]] as the players with [[Matthew Mercer]] as the [[Dungeon Master]]. Campaign three aired each Thursday at 7 p.m. [[Pacific Time Zone|PT]] on [[Critical Role Productions]]' [[Twitch (service)|Twitch]] and [[YouTube]] channels and the [[Beacon (streaming service)|Beacon]] streaming service except for the last Thursday of each month.

The campaign is an [[actual play]] which follows the Bells Hells,<ref>{{cite news |last1=Simpson |first1=Sarah-Jane |title=Will More Critical Role D&D Campaign Books Happen After Netherdeep? |url=https://screenrant.com/dungeons-dragons-campaign-books-critical-role-call-netherdeep/ |access-date=April 5, 2022 |work=Screen Rant |date=March 17, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220322194726/https://screenrant.com/dungeons-dragons-campaign-books-critical-role-call-netherdeep/ |archive-date=March 22, 2022}}</ref> a [[Party (role-playing games)|party]] of [[Player character|adventurers]] who met on the continent of [[Dungeons & Dragons campaign settings#Exandria|Marquet]]. The campaign begins two months before the Apogee Solstice, a celestial event which influences the ley lines of Exandria and magnifies magical abilities. The party gets drawn into the mystery surrounding Exandria's second moon Ruidus and the superstitions around the Ruidusborn, people born during spontaneous flares of the red moon. They eventually discover that the gods crafted Ruidus to imprison an ancient evil known as Predathos and that the Ruby Vanguard – founded and led by Martinet Ludinus Da'leth – seek to free this entity during the Apogee Solstice. The Bells Hells attempted to prevent this by targeting the Malleus Keys, magical devices built by the Ruby Vanguard to aid their ritual.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kopp |first=Drew |date=January 3, 2023 |title=Critical Role Just Revealed the Truth Behind Exandria's Cursed Moon |url=https://www.cbr.com/critical-role-ruidus-cursed-moon-truth-dnd/ |access-date=March 10, 2023 |website=CBR |language=en |archive-date=March 11, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230311042813/https://www.cbr.com/critical-role-ruidus-cursed-moon-truth-dnd/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=McCauley |first=Tara |date=January 6, 2023 |title=Critical Role Hints at a Calamity-Level Threat to Exandria |url=https://www.cbr.com/critical-role-hints-at-a-calamity-level-threat-to-exandria/ |access-date=March 10, 2023 |website=CBR |language=en |archive-date=March 11, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230311042806/https://www.cbr.com/critical-role-hints-at-a-calamity-level-threat-to-exandria/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="ComicBook.com-2023" /> The party interferes with the ritual preventing the release. Afterwards, Ruidus is locked in place over the Hellcatch Valley Malleus Key which allows people to travel between the moon and Exandria.<ref>{{Cite tweet |number=1800604588203999702 |user=criticalrole |title=CATCH UP BEFORE BELLS HELLS LIVE 🔥 Our incredible Lore Keeper, @ItsDaniCarr has the latest from Campaign 3. Grab a ticket & come join us THIS Saturday: [Link] [2 minute recap video] |author-link=Critical Role |date=June 11, 2024 |access-date=June 11, 2024}}</ref> The Exandrian Accord brought together nations and factions from across the world to form a military alliance in opposition to the forces of Ruidus;<ref>{{Cite web |date=August 22, 2024 |title=C3E104 The Cradle's Convocation |url=https://critrole.com/podcast/c3e104-the-cradles-convocation/ |access-date=November 22, 2024 |website=Critical Role |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name="Den of Geek-2024b" /> Bells Hells, along with the adventuring parties [[Vox Machina]] and [[The Mighty Nein|Mighty Nein]], lend their aid as coordinated strike teams against various Ruidian targets.<ref name="Den of Geek-2024b" /><ref name="Critical Role Recap-2024">{{Cite web |last=Carr |first=Dani |date=November 6, 2024 |title=Critical Recap: Critical Role C3E112 'The Assembling of Legends' |url=https://critrole.com/critical-recap-critical-role-c3e112-the-assembling-of-legends/ |access-date=November 22, 2024 |website=Critical Role |language=en-US}}</ref>

*[[Marisha Ray]] as:

She wandered for decades before meeting Imogen in the Taloned Highlands; the two later travelled to Jrusar in 843 PD. Laudna was killed by Otohan Thull of the Ruby Vanguard during a battle at the Paragon's Call fortress which led the Bells Hells to go on a successful quest to magically resurrect her. Later in the campaign, Laudna forms a romantic relationship with Imogen.

=== Casting ===
The way in which guest players were scheduled changed for Campaign Three, moving away from single-episode appearances as had been common before. The third campaign of the Dungeons & Dragons web series Critical Role premiered on October 21, 2021 and concluded on February 6, 2025; it is set after the conclusion of the second campaign and Exandria Unlimited. The series stars Marisha Ray, Ashley Johnson, Laura Bailey, Travis Willingham, Liam O'Brien, Taliesin Jaffe, and Sam Riegel as the players with Matthew Mercer as the Dungeon Master. Campaign three aired each Thursday at 7 p.m. PT on Critical Role Productions' Twitch and YouTube channels and the Beacon streaming service except for the last Thursday of each month.
The campaign is an actual play which follows the Bells Hells, a party of adventurers who met on the continent of Marquet. The campaign begins two months before the Apogee Solstice, a celestial event which influences the ley lines of Exandria and magnifies magical abilities. The party gets drawn into the mystery surrounding Exandria's second moon Ruidus and the superstitions around the Ruidusborn, people born during spontaneous flares of the red moon. They eventually discover that the gods crafted Ruidus to imprison an ancient evil known as Predathos and that the Ruby Vanguard – founded and led by Martinet Ludinus Da'leth – seek to free this entity during the Apogee Solstice. The Bells Hells attempted to prevent this by targeting the Malleus Keys, magical devices built by the Ruby Vanguard to aid their ritual. The party interferes with the ritual preventing the release. Afterwards, Ruidus is locked in place over the Hellcatch Valley Malleus Key which allows people to travel between the moon and Exandria. The Exandrian Accord brought together nations and factions from across the world to form a military alliance in opposition to the forces of Ruidus; Bells Hells, along with the adventuring parties Vox Machina and Mighty Nein, lend their aid as coordinated strike teams against various Ruidian targets.
